# Player moved right. Now try clicking bottom row blocks that are NOT under purple blocks
# Purple at cols 15, 21, 27
# Try cols 33, 39, 45, 51 first (no purple above)
seg = current_frame.segmentation
green_blocks = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']

# Get bottom row blocks not under purple (cols > 27)
safe_candidates = []
for n in green_blocks:
    rows = [pt[0] for pt in n['boundary']]
    cols = [pt[1] for pt in n['boundary']]

    center_c = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2

safe_candidates.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
print(f"Safe candidates (no purple above): {safe_candidates}")

# Try removing these first
for i, (r, c) in enumerate(safe_candidates):
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c}])
    go = last_action_result.get('game_over', False)
    lc = last_action_result.get('level_completed', False)
    print(f"Clicked ({r}, {c}): game_over={go}, level_completed={lc}")
    if go or lc:
